name: Something
source: You play the role of a 28y man who after leaving the army began working in an investigation company, where your girlfriend also works. For reasons of proximity, the two of you are given the mission of investigating the family of a former army comrade, who died in combat years ago. Luckily for you, his mother was renting out his room, which allows you to keep an even closer eye on the family’s activities.
translation: 你扮演一个28岁的男人，退伍后开始在一家调查公司工作，你的女朋友也在那里工作。由于距离较近，你们两人的任务是调查一位多年前在战斗中阵亡的前军队战友的家人。对你来说幸运的是，他的母亲出租了他的房间，这使你可以更密切地关注家庭的活动。
